obligations.source_text: read verbs get CLI parity with the MCP tools: pocketsync search, get, transcript, recordings (list), actions — all --json, all read-only, all runtime verbs under _grant re-exec

obligations.seam: pocketsync web server on an ephemeral loopback port
obligations.behavior: non-loopback bind refused; API endpoints answer through the registry verbs; no third-party import
obligations.source_text: pocketsync web is a stdlib ThreadingHTTPServer (like webhook/server.py) bound to loopback only on a new setting POCKETSYNC_WEB_PORT (default 8788), serving one self-contained HTML/JS page plus a JSON API (/api/chat, /api/search, /api/recordings, /api/recordings/<id>, /api/actions, /api/enrich) that calls the same retrieval/enrich core as CLI and MCP — no extra dependency and no second retrieval implementation

obligations.seam: web /api/chat with a fake chat client
obligations.behavior: every citation names a retrieved id and an in-range timestamp; zero hits yields a found-nothing answer with no citations
obligations.source_text: chat answers are generated by the configured chat model from retrieved chunks only, and every answer cites recordings with ids and start/end timestamps; clicking a citation opens that recording's transcript at the timestamp; a per-recording and per-result-set Re-enrich button calls the enrich operation (dry-run preview, then apply)

obligations.behavior: unit runs pocketsync web under grant run --inject; pocketchat.culture.dev unauthenticated returns 302; pocketsync.culture.dev routes unchanged
obligations.source_text: deploy adds deploy/systemd/pocketsync-web.service (grant run --inject, like pocketsync-serve) and a runbook section adding pocketchat.culture.dev as a second ingress hostname on the existing remote-managed pocketsync-culture-dev tunnel with a Cloudflare Access app allowing only the operator email and no Bypass; web verifies the Access JWT (team domain + audience settings) on every request

obligations.source_text: on the live deploy: pocketsync search returns the matching recording first for >= 3 of 3 operator-chosen probe questions; a chat answer cites >= 1 recording with a timestamp; pocketsync enrich --status error --apply drains to 0 retrying within one worker cycle when the gateway is up; recall.culture.dev returns 302 unauthenticated

obligations.behavior: all jobs green with the parity test, coverage >= 60%, Sonar new issues 0
obligations.source_text: test suite: CLI↔MCP parity test passes for 100% of registry verbs, the full suite stays green and coverage stays >= 60%, teken cli doctor --strict passes, Sonar new issues = 0

obligations.behavior: a requeue issued while the worker holds the doc leaves it pending and it is re-enriched next cycle
obligations.source_text: re-queue is race-safe against an in-flight worker: enrich --apply bumps enrichment.generation and the worker's set_enrichment / set_enrichment_error CAS matches content_hash AND the generation it claimed, so a requeue issued mid-processing is not overwritten to done (today the CAS is on content_hash only, sinks/mongo.py set_enrichment)

obligations.behavior: HTML in a synthetic transcript renders escaped; CSP header present; foreign-Origin or non-JSON POST returns 403
obligations.source_text: web output is XSS-safe and the mutating API is CSRF-safe: transcript/summary/model text is rendered only via textContent (never innerHTML), responses carry a strict Content-Security-Policy (no inline script from data, default-src self), and POST /api/enrich and /api/chat require Content-Type application/json plus an Origin header equal to the configured site origin

obligations.behavior: the chat completions request carries no tools/functions field
obligations.source_text: the chat model and the MCP surface get no tools or side effects driven by model output: retrieved transcript text is untrusted context (prompt-injection), the chat model only produces text, and enrich runs only from an explicit operator click or CLI/MCP call with apply

obligations.seam: web Access verifier with a local RSA key + fake JWKS
obligations.behavior: missing/forged/expired/wrong-aud tokens get 403; partial config refuses start; unreachable JWKS gives 503
obligations.source_text: the Access JWT check fails closed: pocketsync web refuses to start without POCKETSYNC_ACCESS_TEAM_DOMAIN and POCKETSYNC_ACCESS_AUD unless run with an explicit --no-access-check (loopback dev only, loud warning); JWKS (https://<team>.cloudflareaccess.com/cdn-cgi/access/certs) is fetched lazily, cached, refreshed on unknown kid, and an unreachable JWKS yields 503 not allow

obligations.behavior: request disables thinking and caps context; think blocks are stripped; chat-lane failure returns 503 with citations
obligations.source_text: the chat request disables reasoning output for thinking models (chat_template_kwargs enable_thinking false and strips any leftover think block), caps the retrieved context (top 8 chunks, ~6000 chars) and the answer length, and returns 503 with the retrieved citations still listed when the chat lane is down

obligations.behavior: returns keyword matches labelled mode=keyword instead of erroring
obligations.source_text: when query embedding fails (embed lane down) search degrades to a case-insensitive keyword match over title, summary and chunk text with recording-level filters, and says so in the result (mode: keyword)

obligations.behavior: the log line for a chat request has method, path, status, duration and no question/answer text
obligations.source_text: web access logging records method, path without query string, status and duration only — never question text, request bodies or answers
